newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lam Research upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lam Research upgraded.

text.p: -- ABN AMRO Chicago Corp said Wednesday it upgraded Lam Research Corp to buy from hold with a price target of $50 for the next six to 12 months.
-- ABN AMRO said it became convinced gross margins and earnings per share bottomed out in the second quarter of fiscal 1997 after a conference call with the company Tuesday.
-- The company posted net income of $0.08 per share in the second quarter, compared to $1.12 one year ago.
-- Improvements in cost of goods sold for Lam Research's Alliance cluster platform to the A6 family should reduce costs in the third and fourth quarters of 1997, ABN AMRO said.
-- Lam Research makes semiconductor processing equipment.
-- Its shares were up 5/8 Wednesday at 37-3/4.
